title: Dependency, Compression, and Synergy: A Unified Information-Theoretic View of Multimodal Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.14421v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have intensified the need to understand how different modalities share, preserve, and complement information. Mutual Information (MI), the Information Bottleneck (IB), and Partial Information Decomposition (PID) provide complementary perspectives, yet existing studies often treat them as isolated tools. This survey presents an information-theoretic perspective connecting these principles as progressively refined views of multimodal information processing: MI characterizes inter-modal dependency, IB explains task-oriented information preservation under compression, and PID decomposes preserved information into redundancy, uniqueness, and synergy. translated_title: 依赖、压缩与协同：多模态学习的统一信息论视角
translated_abstract: 近期多模态基础模型的进展使得理解不同模态之间如何共享、保留和补充信息的需求愈发迫切。互信息（MI）、信息瓶颈（IB）和部分信息分解（PID）提供了互补的视角，然而现有研究往往将它们视为孤立的工具。本综述提出了一种信息论视角，将这些原理联系起来，形成对多模态信息处理逐步精炼的统一视图：MI刻画模态间的依赖关系，IB解释在压缩约束下面向任务的信息保留，PID则将保留的信息分解为冗余、独特性和协同性。我们回顾了170篇近期研究（2018—2026年）和12篇奠基性工作，并围绕四大挑战组织多模态学习的讨论：跨模态对齐、信息高效融合、交互类型刻画，以及向多模态基础模型的可扩展性。
tldr: 本综述提出统一的信息论框架，将互信息、信息瓶颈与部分信息分解串接为递进的多模态信息处理视角，并围绕跨模态对齐、信息高效融合、交互类型刻画和基础模型扩展四大挑战系统梳理了170余篇相关研究。
en_tdlr: This survey presents a unified information-theoretic view that connects Mutual Information, the Information Bottleneck, and Partial Information Decomposition as progressively refined perspectives on multimodal information processing, organizing over 170 studies around four key challenges: cross-modal alignment, information-efficient fusion, interaction-type characterization, and scaling to multimodal foundation models.
